assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable cationic lipids that are neutral in circulation and charged in the acidic endosome, formulated into lipid nanoparticles, turned lipid self-assembly and bilayer phase behaviour (including non-bilayer, hexagonal-phase-prone lipids and fusion) into a deliverable medicine platform. It is a clear case of physical chemistry of lipid assemblies producing a chemical invention with very large practical impact (siRNA and mRNA vaccines and therapeutics).
assessment.attribution: The Vancouver group (Cullis with Hope and Madden) built the core lipid-assembly and formulation science over decades; Anderson, Langer and MacLachlan made important later contributions in lipidoid materials and clinical translation. A three-person prize around the Cullis-group core is plausible, but the line between invention of the lipid and formulation versus later optimization is contestable.
assessment.maturity: Clinically validated at global scale and independently reproduced across many lipid designs. Timely given the 2023 Medicine prize for nucleoside modification, which recognized the cargo but not the carrier.
uncertainties: Allocation of credit among the Vancouver group, the Anderson/Langer lipidoid line, and industrial developers is unresolved.
Chemistry rather than Medicine framing could be argued either way; I rely on memory for the detailed history and have not verified patent or priority claims.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Showing that cells organize biochemistry through liquid-liquid phase separation of proteins and nucleic acids reframed intracellular organization as a physical-chemical phase phenomenon. It is conceptually original, links polymer physics and thermodynamics to cell biology, and has broad influence on disease studies (including amyloid transitions).
assessment.attribution: Brangwynne and Hyman established the liquid-droplet behaviour of P granules; Rosen and colleagues showed multivalency-driven phase separation in signaling assemblies. Pappu and Mittag provided sequence-encoded physical theory and rheology. Three laureates is feasible but excludes important theorists.
assessment.maturity: Rapidly growing and widely replicated, but interpretation is still debated: the physiological relevance of many reported condensates, and how rigorously phase separation is demonstrated in vivo, remain contested. Possibly slightly premature.
uncertainties: Debate over whether many condensates are true phase separation versus other assemblies, and over in vivo relevance.
Credit split between experimental discoverers and physical-chemistry theorists is open.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors chemically convert one base to another at a target site without double-strand breaks, by fusing deaminase chemistry to a programmable DNA-binding protein. A genuinely chemical design concept with immediate therapeutic uptake.
assessment.attribution: Liu led the conceptual and technical development; Komor and Gaudelli were lead authors of the cytosine and adenine base editor papers as trainees, and Nishida and Kondo reported a related deaminase-fusion approach. A sole or lead-laureate configuration around Liu is defensible, with the trainee and parallel-work credit as an open question.
assessment.maturity: Several editors are in clinical trials with early patient data, and the approach has been widely reproduced. Timely, though long-term clinical safety evidence is still accumulating.
uncertainties: Overlap with the CRISPR prize (2020) and with the prime-editing candidate; whether the committee prefers a combined Liu configuration.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Hijacking the ubiquitin-proteasome system with bifunctional PROTACs and molecular glues enables degradation of previously undruggable proteins, and the discovery that thalidomide-type drugs act through cereblon gave a mechanism for glue degraders. A new chemical modality with broad conceptual reach.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated the PROTAC concept; Handa and Ito identified cereblon as the thalidomide target; Ciulli, Gray and others drove structure-based design. Eight credited names make a three-person selection necessarily exclusionary.
assessment.maturity: Many degraders are in clinical trials, but approvals are still pending, so clinical validation of the modality is incomplete. Somewhat early.
uncertainties: No approved PROTAC drug yet, so timing may be premature.
Splitting PROTAC conception from molecular-glue mechanism is a difficult attribution problem.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visible-light photoredox catalysis opened mild single-electron routes to radical intermediates and is now ubiquitous in synthesis and medicinal chemistry. It is a major methodological shift, though it is outside my own field.
assessment.attribution: The 2008 reports by Yoon, Stephenson and MacMillan are central; MacMillan already shares the 2021 organocatalysis prize, which complicates his inclusion, and Fukuzumi, Konig, Melchiorre and others have strong claims. I propose the three groups that are not prior laureates, but the configuration is contestable.
assessment.maturity: Widely reproduced, industrially adopted, and mature after more than fifteen years.
uncertainties: Prior-laureate overlap for MacMillan and priority claims from earlier photochemistry make a clean configuration difficult.
I judge synthesis impact mainly from general knowledge.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Native mass spectrometry preserves non-covalent assemblies in the gas phase and measures stoichiometry, interactions and, notably, lipid binding to intact membrane protein complexes. It connects directly to the physical chemistry of membrane assemblies and is widely used in structural biology.
assessment.attribution: Robinson made decisive contributions to intact complexes and membrane proteins; Heck and Chait contributed key methods and applications; Loo and Gross have earlier claims. Three names are a plausible configuration, with some exclusion of early pioneers.
assessment.maturity: Well established and independently reproduced across many laboratories. Overlap with the 2002 ESI prize may make some members consider it incremental.
uncertainties: Whether native MS is a sufficiently distinct advance beyond electrospray ionization recognized in 2002.
Gas-phase structures versus solution structures remain an occasionally debated point.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Expanding the genetic code with orthogonal aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase/tRNA pairs lets proteins carry designed chemical functionality in living cells. This is a conceptually original chemical biology tool with lasting use, including for probes of membrane proteins.
assessment.attribution: Schultz and colleagues established the first orthogonal pairs and unnatural amino acid incorporation in vivo; Chin extended it to multicellular organisms and genome-wide recoding; Wang was a lead contributor in Schultz's lab. Yokoyama and Mehl have supporting claims.
assessment.maturity: Mature and widely adopted, though therapeutic applications are still emerging.
uncertainties: Possible overlap with directed evolution or phage display prizes in conceptual terms.
Credit among early orthogonal-pair developers is not fully clear to me.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nanopore sensing uses protein pores embedded in lipid bilayers to read single DNA and RNA molecules electrically; it combines membrane biophysics, protein engineering and analytical chemistry, and has produced a commercial sequencing technology.
assessment.attribution: Deamer, Branton and Akeson proposed and demonstrated strand translocation; Kasianowicz showed polynucleotide passage through alpha-hemolysin; Bayley engineered pores and enzymes. I am unsure of the current status of some credited individuals, which would constrain eligibility.
assessment.maturity: Technology is commercially mature, with independent verification and broad use, but its overlap with sequencing prizes and long timelines are considerations.
uncertainties: Eligibility of deceased or older nominees is uncertain to me and is not verified.
Credit between the proposal of nanopore sequencing and the engineering that made it work is contested.
